suite: DFARM Multi-Dairy Customer Membership & Identity Verification

tests.name: Database Environment Pre-Flight & Provisioning
assertions: Organizations seeded in control plane
Dairy centers seeded in control plane
Global identity and membership tables verified

tests.name: Rule 1: One Global Customer Identity per verified mobile number
assertions: OTP requested via real Dove SMS Gateway
OTP verified and canonical E.164 phone normalized
globalCustomerId UUID generated
Re-login idempotent with stable globalCustomerId

tests.name: Rule 2 & 3: Register in Dairy A (Success) & Duplicate within Dairy A (Rejected)
assertions: Registration in Dairy A returns 201 Created
Status is PENDING_APPROVAL
Duplicate registration attempt returns 400 Bad Request
Error matches /already exists/i

tests.name: Rule 2: Same Customer Identity Registering in Dairy B is Allowed
tests.target: Dairy B Tenant DB & Central Directory
assertions: Registration in Dairy B returns 201 Created
New tenant customer UUID created in Dairy B
Duplicate in Dairy B returns 400 Bad Request

tests.name: Membership Discovery Directory returns all memberships with isolated statuses
assertions: Returns exactly 2 memberships
Dairy A membership discovered with status PENDING_APPROVAL
Dairy B membership discovered with status PENDING_APPROVAL

tests.name: Rule 4: Independent Membership Lifecycle & Admin Approvals
assertions: Dairy Admin A approves customer with farmer code C-WARNA-101
Dairy Admin B rejects customer with mandatory reason
Central directory reflects Dairy A as APPROVED and Dairy B as REJECTED

tests.name: Rule 5: Dairy Switching & Tenant Scoped JWT Generation
assertions: Switch to APPROVED Dairy A returns 200 with tenant-scoped token
Token claims match Dairy A organizationId and role FARMER_CUSTOMER
Switch to REJECTED Dairy B is strictly rejected (400)

tests.name: Rule 5: Strict Operational Tenant Isolation across Dairies
assertions: Customer profile scoped to Dairy A tenant ID
Collections history queries Dairy A tenant database
Ledger summary queries Dairy A tenant database
Bills query Dairy A tenant database with zero cross-tenant leakage
